name: Cava
author: syzyf97
description: Audio visualizer in the bar, powered by cava and colored by the current theme

schema.label: Audio source
schema.description: What the bars listen to: "output" is whatever is playing on the default output, "input" is the default microphone, or a PipeWire device name to pin one device (list them with omarchy-cava-settings --sources).

schema.label: Frame rate
schema.description: How many times per second the bars update. Higher is smoother and uses a little more CPU.

schema.label: Highest frequency (Hz)
schema.description: Highest frequency shown, in Hz. Always kept at least 100 Hz above lowFreq.

schema.label: Sensitivity (%)
schema.description: Bar height in percent. With autoSensitivity Off, quiet music usually needs 500-2000. With autoSensitivity On, this is only the starting value.

schema.label: Auto sensitivity
schema.description: On lets cava adjust sensitivity to the volume, so bars neither clip nor stay flat.

schema.label: Color
schema.description: Theme color of the bars: foreground is the bar text color, accent is the theme accent.

schema.label: Hide when silent
schema.description: On hides the widget while nothing is playing; Off keeps it visible and dimmed.
